Person.reason: Pty represents parties, with IsCstmr identifying bank customers.

Transaction.reason: Credit-transfer records describe transfers, but the schema does not establish that each was completed.

Device.reason: No device vertex or attribute is present.

IPAddress.reason: No network-address vertex or attribute is present.

LoginEvent.reason: No sign-on or authentication records are present.

Beneficiary.reason: The creditor party can represent the external recipient; IsCstmr distinguishes noncustomers.

Card.reason: No card vertex or attribute is present.

Merchant.reason: No merchant vertex or attribute is present.

OWNS.reason: CshAcct_Ownr links parties to accounts; the customer filter selects bank customers.

INITIATED.reason: The debtor-account edge identifies the account from which the transfer is debited.

PAYS_TO_ACCOUNT.reason: The creditor-account edge identifies the account receiving the transfer.

PAYS.reason: The creditor party is the recipient; the filter selects parties that are not bank customers.

FROM_DEVICE.reason: No device vertex or transaction-to-device path is present.

FROM_IP.reason: No IP address vertex or transaction-to-address path is present.

AT.reason: No merchant vertex or transaction-to-merchant path is present.

VIA.reason: No card vertex or transaction-to-card path is present.

HOLDS.reason: No card vertex or account-to-card path is present.

LOGGED_IN.reason: No login-event vertex or sign-on-to-account path is present.

LOGIN_FROM_DEVICE.reason: No login-event or device vertices and no connecting path are present.

LOGIN_FROM_IP.reason: No login-event or IP address vertices and no connecting path are present.

INVESTIGATED_IN.reason: AMLAlrtInd is an account alert flag, not a case vertex or account-to-case relation.

Transaction.amount.reason: IntrBkSttlmAmt is the interbank settlement amount.

Transaction.timestamp.reason: AccptncDtTm provides an acceptance date-time with time of day.

Transaction.channel.reason: taken from the transfer itself; pacs.008 credit transfers are electronic

Account.open_date.reason: OpngDt is the account opening date.

Account.status.reason: Sts records account status; its values may require a lookup.

Account.kyc_score.reason: No account-level KYC score is present.

Person.anonymized_ssn_hash.reason: Id_Hash is a hashed private identifier, but its scheme may not be a national identity number.

Beneficiary.bank_identifier.reason: The creditor agent provides the recipient bank's BIC or clearing-system member identifier.

Beneficiary.name_hash.reason: Nm_Hash is a hashed party name; the filter selects noncustomer parties.

InvestigationCase.status.reason: No investigation cases or case status attributes are present.

IPAddress.anonymizer.reason: No IP address or anonymizer indicator is present.

account_under_investigation.reason: AMLAlrtInd is an alert indicator, not confirmation of an investigation case.

needs_review: Pty.IsCstmr is BOOL; the true and false filter values are inferred from its name and should be confirmed.
Confirm that CdtTrfTxInf records represent completed transfers in this data, rather than only accepted payment instructions.
Confirm that PmtInf.PmtMtd is an adequate proxy for transaction channel.
Confirm that PrvtId.Id_Hash uses a national identity scheme before treating it as an anonymized SSN hash.
Confirm the code values and meanings for CshAcct.Sts and PmtInf.PmtMtd.

review.by: Claude (reviewer for the demo; the bank's data owner reviews for real)

changes.why: The proposal used PmtInf.PmtMtd, which is on the batch order, not the transfer. Every pacs.008 transfer is an electronic interbank payment, so all of them count as online; the local instrument code is kept as the source so instant payments stay identifiable.
